Class InventoryPage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
InventoryPage
public class InventoryPage extends Manager.Page
Manager page for viewing, adding and editing inventory items and their quantities. Also provides a view of inventory items not used by any currently available menu items.

  • Method Details

    • show

      public void show()
      Shows the inventory table with its Add, Edit, and Unused Inventory buttons, then loads every inventory item from the database.
      Specified by:
      show in class Manager.Page
      See Also:
      • Manager.Page.show()

    • loadInventory

      private void loadInventory()
      Loads every inventory item into the table, ordered by item ID. Displays a database error message if the query fails.

    • addInventoryItem

      private void addInventoryItem()
      Asks for a new inventory item and adds it with the next available ID. The insert is performed in a transaction, and the inventory table is refreshed after a successful insert. If the form is cancelled or contains invalid values, no item is added.

    • editInventoryItem

      private void editInventoryItem()
      Changes the selected inventory item's details and quantity. The form is prefilled with the item's current values, and the inventory table is refreshed after a successful update. If no item is selected or the form is cancelled or invalid, the update is not performed.

    • showUnusedInventory

      private void showUnusedInventory()
      Shows inventory items not used by any currently available menu item, excluding the special bag inventory item.

      Some listed items may be ingredients used only by limited-time menu items that are currently out of season. Displays the results in a dialog. If the database query fails, displays an error and does not open the dialog.

    • showInventoryForm

      private InventoryPage.InventoryValues showInventoryForm(String title, String name, String quantity, String unit, String desiredFillLevel, String price)
      Shows the add or edit form filled with the given text and returns the validated values, or null if the form is cancelled or invalid.

      The name and unit must not be empty, and the quantity, desired fill level, and price must be valid non-negative decimal numbers. Displays a warning if the entered values are invalid.

      Parameters:
      title - the title displayed on the form
      name - the initial inventory item name
      quantity - the initial current quantity
      unit - the initial unit of measurement
      desiredFillLevel - the initial desired fill level
      price - the initial price
      Returns:
      the validated inventory values, or null if cancelled or invalid

    • setInventoryValues

      Puts an item's name, quantity, unit, desired fill level, and price into the prepared statement, starting at the specified parameter index.
      Parameters:

      item - the inventory values to assign
